# Murray John Telfer (Adopted)

**Born:** 1911 | **Died:** 1982 | **Buried:** ?

Adopted son of Mark Telfer (1877–1946) and Julia Matilda Seebohm (1876–1939). Adopted circa 1911 along with biological brother [[Gilbert Melville Telfer (1911–1978)]].

> **Note:** This is a **different person** from the Telfer patriarch **Murray John Telfer (1924–2009)**, who was the son of Francis Charles Telfer and Amy Ellen Telfer, and grandfather of Mark Kenneth Telfer (1986–?). The similar names are coincidental.

## Life Summary

Murray John Telfer was adopted by Mark and Julia Telfer around 1911, the same year their biological son Melvin was born. He was raised at Tantanoola and North Millicent, South Australia, alongside his adoptive siblings.

Little is known about his biological parents or his life after adoption. He died in 1982.
